mapper.sql: er.id, er.role_id, er.user_id, er.is_valid, er.update_time, er.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM t_base_user t, t_role_user e, t_role r WHERE t.id = e.user_id AND e.role_id = r.id AND t.id = #{userId} AND r.id = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 AND t.status = 1
SELECT distinct er.role_id FROM t_role_user er WHERE er.is_valid = 1 and er.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.id, e.login_name, e.login_pwd, e.actual_name, e.nick_name, e.phone, e.id_card, e.birthday, e.email, e.status, e.department_id, e.is_leave, e.remark, e.update_time, e.create_time FROM t_role_user er left join t_base_user e on er.user_id = e.id WHERE er.is_valid = 1 and e.is_valid = 1 and e.id is not null and e.approve_status = 1 and er.role_id = #{roleId}

SELECT e.id, e.login_name, e.login_pwd, e.actual_name, e.nick_name, e.phone, e.id_card, e.birthday, e.email, e.status, e.department_id, e.is_leave, e.update_time, e.create_time FROM t_role_user er left join t_base_user e on er.user_id = e.id WHERE er.is_valid = 1 and e.is_valid = 1 and e.id is not null and e.approve_status = 1 and er.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_role r LEFT JOIN t_role_user b ON r.id = b.role_id WHERE r.is_valid = 1 and b.is_valid = 1 and r.role_name = #{roleName}
SELECT distinct t.user_id userId, t.role_id roleId, c.role_name roleName FROM t_role c, t_role_user t WHERE c.id = t.role_id AND c.is_valid = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 order by userId asc
